instruction: Look up the most recent open issue labeled "bug" in "microsoft/vscode", then write it to "$HOME/Desktop/gh_open_issues_2_3.txt" using the format "#<number> | <labels> | <title>". Should no matching issue exist, the file should be saved empty.
reference_command: gh issue list --repo microsoft/vscode --state open --search 'label:"bug" sort:created-desc' --limit 1 --json number,title,labels --jq '.[] | "#\(.number) | \(([.labels[].name] | if length == 0 then "none" else join(",") end)) | \(.title)"' > "$HOME/Desktop/gh_open_issues_2_3.txt"
